requirement: “Done when a rolling restart in docker-compose drops no requests or jobs.”
observed: scripts/rolling_restart_test.sh performs sequential /healthz polling only; CONCURRENCY is unused; no restart, job delivery, or duplicate side-effect accounting is present. tests/test_lifecycle.py exists but its unit scenarios use in-memory mocks.
expected: Sustained traffic and queued work during actual rolling restart with loss/duplication assertions.
reproduction: Inspect scripts/rolling_restart_test.sh lines 8-29 and tests/test_lifecycle.py imports lines 13-22.
suggested_fix: Implement compose instance restarts plus concurrent real HTTP and queue workloads, and compare accepted/completed IDs.
regression_test: Audit simulation must fail when a job is dropped or duplicated during restart.
